definition: to be ready and happy to do something
description: In a warm living room in the evening, a young woman in a red long-sleeved top and cream wide trousers smiles as she presses a drinking glass over a big spider on the white wall and slides a sheet of paper under it, talking calmly. Behind her a young man in a green hoodie and a young woman in a pink slip dress stand on the mustard sofa, holding on to each other, then climb down and watch nervously from behind her. Cushions lie on the floor, and a shelf with potted plants hangs above.

taps.phrase: to wear a pink slip dress
to hold a sheet of paper
